mapper.select: SELECT cm.conversation_id, c.last_message_time, cm.is_toped FROM conversation_member cm LEFT JOIN conversation c ON cm.conversation_id = c.id WHERE cm.user_id = #{userId} AND cm.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY cm.is_toped DESC, c.last_message_time DESC LIMIT #{preHeatCount}; -- 先查前200个

SELECT m.conversation_id AS conversationId, m.is_toped AS isToped, c.last_message_time AS lastMessageTime FROM conversation_member m JOIN conversation c ON m.conversation_id = c.id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND ( -- 情况A：如果上一条是置顶的 (lastIsToped = 1) -- 那么我们可以取：同为置顶且时间更早的，或者 任何非置顶的 (is_toped = 0) (#{lastIsToped} = 1 AND ( (m.is_toped = 1 AND c.last_message_time < #{lastTime}) OR (m.is_toped = 0) )) OR -- 情况B：如果上一条是非置顶的 (lastIsToped = 0) -- 那么我们只能取：非置顶且时间更早的 (#{lastIsToped} = 0 AND ( m.is_toped = 0 AND c.last_message_time < #{lastTime} )) ) ORDER BY m.is_toped DESC, c.last_message_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.id AS id, c.type AS type, IF(c.type = 0, ( SELECT u.nickname FROM conversation_member other_cm JOIN user u ON u.id = other_cm.user_id WHERE other_cm.conversation_id = c.id AND other_cm.user_id != #{userId} LIMIT 1 ), c.title) AS title, IF(c.type = 0, ( SELECT u.avatar FROM conversation_member other_cm JOIN user u ON u.id = other_cm.user_id WHERE other_cm.conversation_id = c.id AND other_cm.user_id != #{userId} LIMIT 1 ), c.avatar) AS avatar, c.last_message_content AS lastMessageContent, c.last_message_time AS lastMessageTime, cm.is_toped AS isTop, cm.is_muted AS isMuted, ( SELECT count(*) FROM chat_message m WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id AND m.id > IFNULL(cm.last_read_message_id, 0) ) AS unreadCount FROM conversation c INNER JOIN conversation_member cm ON c.id = cm.conversation_id WHERE cm.user_id = #{userId} AND cm.is_deleted = 0 AND (c.last_message_time > #{syncTime} OR cm.updated_time > #{syncTime}) ORDER BY cm.is_toped DESC, c.last_message_time DESC LIMIT 200
